📘 Grammar Tip: SINCE vs FOR

✅ Use FOR with a period of time: for 3 years, for two hours.
✅ Use SINCE with a starting point: since 2020, since Monday.

💬 Example: I have lived here for 5 years. / I have lived here since 2021.

"Agree" is already a verb, so we don't use "am" before it.

📘 Grammar Tip: MUCH vs MANY

✅ MANY goes with countable nouns: many books, many friends.
✅ MUCH goes with uncountable nouns: much water, much time.

💡 We use them mostly in questions and negatives:
"How many books do you have?" / "I don't have much time."

✍️ Write your own sentence with "much" or "many" in the comments 👇

#Speaklo #LearnEnglish #EnglishGrammar #MuchVsMany
items.source: Cambridge Grammar: much + uncountable, many + plural countable; mostly questions/negatives
